descriptor: Phase Two growth plan, stakeholder follow-up, and pilot selection
status: The Phase Two package is complete and review-ready; production remains paused pending a client decision
signal: The twelve-page Phase Two growth package remained the August source of truth. A direct stakeholder follow-up was sent, while implementation and budget decisions stayed paused until the first pilot, owner, and success measure are approved.
goal: Choose one realistic first pilot, assign its owner and success measure, and convert the approved priority into a dated production sequence.
work: Kept the Phase Two growth package as the governing August plan.
Sent a direct stakeholder follow-up on August 4 to move the review toward a decision.
Preserved the seven proposed growth lanes without presenting any of them as approved production.
Held publishing, paid media, and budget work behind a clear client decision and measurement owner.
analysis: August was a decision month rather than a production month. The strategic package is complete, but the next value depends on selecting a bounded first pilot instead of opening several lanes at once.
No paid-media delivery or implementation result is claimed while the account remains paused.
